summary: [Shopify] authorization: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow: merchant approves comma-separated scopes (read_products, write_orders...); app gets a permanent offline access token sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token. Never share store admin credentials: OAuth is the only legitimate pattern. Webhook signing: app client secret (API-created subs) vs store-level secret in Settings > Notifications (hand-created subs): different values.
